sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
EXTRAs module integration tools ka collection hai — jo hotel ko external systems se connect karte hain:

- Channel Manager: OTA bookings (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com etc.) aur rate/inventory sync
- WhatsApp: automatic guest messages (booking confirm, check-in/out, offers)
- Smart Card: card based payments (Members module ke saath)
- E-Invoice: GST e-invoice generation (IRN) for B2B bills

Ye module mostly admin/IT use karta hai — ek baar setup hota hai, phir automatic chalta hai.

subsections.navPath: EXTRAs ▶ Channel Manager ▶ Update Rates / Run Derived Pricing
subsections.paragraph: HMS me room rates update karo aur derived pricing rules se OTAs pe rates push karo (e.g. HMS rate +15% = OTA rate). Run Derived Pricing sab channels pe rates sync karta hai.

Channel-specific markup/discount rules apply karke push
OTA credentials — kaunsa channel, API keys, mapping

subsections.title: 3.1 WhatsApp Enviro & Templates
subsections.navPath: EXTRAs ▶ What's App ▶ WhatsApp Enviro / Templates
subsections.paragraph: WhatsApp API provider credentials setup aur message templates. Templates: booking confirmation, check-in instructions, welcome, checkout bill, feedback link, offers. Template me dynamic variables (guest name, room no., dates) hote hain.

rows: API URL, key, sender number, balance status
Event-based messages — trigger points set karo
Booking created / Day before arrival / On check-in / On checkout / Payment received

steps: Template approve karwao (WhatsApp policy) — system me setup
Trigger event hotel me hota hai (e.g. guest check-in)
System guest ke number pe template message bhejta hai
Delivery report/balance dashboard me dikhta hai
Balance low ho to recharge (dashboard warning dikhata hai)

subsections.title: 4.1 Card Lifecycle Screens
subsections.caption: Card Refund — card lifecycle ka last step
subsections.paragraph: Members module ke saath card based payment system — blank cards initialize karo, member ko issue karo (registration), recharge karo, cancel pe refund. Detail training Members Management manual me hai — yahan admin setup side hai.

subsections.title: 5.1 EInvoice Parameter
subsections.paragraph: GST portal/API credentials — company GSTIN, e-invoice API keys, applicable document types (B2B invoices only), auto-generate threshold (Rs 5 crore turnover wale ke liye mandatory).

rows: Bill save pe auto IRN ya manual trigger

subsections.title: 5.2 EInvoice Flow & Report
subsections.paragraph: B2B bill settle hone pe e-invoice generate hota hai — IRN (Invoice Reference Number) + QR code milta hai jo bill pe print hota hai. EInvoice Report me saare generated e-invoices ka record + cancellation option.
steps: B2B guest/company ka bill settle karo
E-invoice auto-generate — IRN + QR bill pe aa jata hai
Galat hua to EInvoice Report se cancel (24hr window)
Monthly — GSTR-1 me ye invoices auto-match
